description: This file is a frontend HTML page for a Database Viewer web application. It provides UI components for browsing databases, tables, and data, including dynamic loading, user interactions, and styling. The embedded JavaScript manages fetching data from backend APIs, updating the UI, and handling user interactions such as refreshing, expanding cells, and toggling database and table views.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database in the sidebar and loads associated tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table, showing a table view with rows and columns.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds HTML for a data table from JSON array of rows and inserts into the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expand/collapse feature.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles click events to toggle expanded view of cell content.
